sources.title: Gedanken-Experiments on Sequential Machines
sources.enterprise_use: Provides classical finite deterministic sequential-machine language with state-dependent output and behavioral distinguishability; E002 uses it as prior art for treating future input/output behavior as a state-equivalence criterion.
sources.not_claimed: Finite-state output machines, behavioral state distinguishability, and Moore-machine concepts are established prior work and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: An n log n Algorithm for Minimizing States in a Finite Automaton
sources.enterprise_use: Provides established partition-refinement state minimization for finite automata; E002 explicitly treats predictive quotient compilation as a finite-state minimization specialization rather than an original minimization algorithm.
sources.not_claimed: Finite automaton minimization, partition refinement, and efficient state-minimization algorithms are established prior work.
